Archivist.description: A member of the archive's staff. A first name alone is not an identity.

Collection.description: A body of papers or images held by the archive.

Role.description:
Who looks after a collection, as its cataloguer or its conservator.
Cataloguing a collection does not mean conserving it.

Cover.description: A working tie between two archivists: one stands in for the other, or trains the other.

Retrieval.description: Boxes pulled from a collection for the reading room. state says asked, ready or returned; handled_with_gloves stays empty until a handling note exists.

messages.text:
From: Imre Valkonen
To: Hanneke Valkonen, Odile Szentkuti
Subject: Milldam Ledgers

Hanneke, you catalogued the first 12 boxes and Odile conserved the water-damaged ones. I only fetched them, so please do not credit me with either.
Present: Imre Valkonen, Imre Szentkuti, Priyanka Aldous. Action: Valkonen to digitise the Quillon Maps, Szentkuti to review, and Imre to report back by Friday.

Reading room: "The maps are fragile," said Priyanka Aldous. "Then wear gloves," Rustam Nasyrov answered. I wrote "gloves only for the vellum ones" in the log, and the porter muttered "nobody told me".
quotes: gloves only for the vellum ones

messages.text:
Priyanka Aldous: I am cataloguer for the Quillon Maps, and my deputy is Rustam Nasyrov.
Rustam Nasyrov: I am her deputy only on paper. My real job is the Hollis Street Photographs, and my trainer there was Pelagia Dovey.

facts.in: I am cataloguer for the Quillon Maps
facts.label: cataloguer

facts.in: my trainer there was Pelagia Dovey
facts.label: trains

messages.text: Imre Valkonen and Imre Szentkuti signed out the Milldam Ledgers, and Imre from the conservation lab countersigned. He said "all three of us were in the room" afterwards.
quotes: all three of us were in the room

messages.text:
> Pelagia Dovey wrote:
> The Hollis Street Photographs are ready, and I have approved the 6 boxes.

Forwarding that to Tobiah Lumsden, who asked me last week.

facts.in: The Hollis Street Photographs are ready, and I have approved the 6 boxes.

messages.text: Hanneke Valkonen asked Odile Szentkuti whether she could cover the evening desk, but she said her own shift ran late and she would ask Tobiah Lumsden instead.
Conservator of the Quillon Maps is Odile Szentkuti, not Rustam Nasyrov, whatever the old catalogue says.

facts.in: Conservator of the Quillon Maps is Odile Szentkuti
facts.label: conservator

messages.text:
Dear Tobiah,

Please tell Pelagia that Priyanka Aldous trains me on Tuesdays, so I cannot also shadow Pelagia Dovey. Priyanka and Pelagia agreed in March that I would split my time.

Warm regards,
Hanneke

Voicemail transcript: "Hello, it is the courier. We have the crates for the Milldam Ledgers and we will leave them with your colleague." I assume they meant Imre Szentkuti, since he signs for deliveries.
quotes: Hello, it is the courier. We have the crates for the Milldam Ledgers and we will leave them with your colleague.

messages.text: Imre Valkonen: Could Hanneke Valkonen pull 3 boxes of the Quillon Maps, shelfmark QM 7, for Monday? Valkonen said the reading room wants them flat.

facts.in: Could Hanneke Valkonen pull 3 boxes of the Quillon Maps, shelfmark QM 7, for Monday?

messages.text: Rustam Nasyrov did not approve the Hollis Street Photographs; Pelagia Dovey did, and she says he never even opened the boxes.

facts.in: Rustam Nasyrov did not approve the Hollis Street Photographs

messages.text: Odile Szentkuti told the board that the Milldam Ledgers returned on Tuesday with gloves worn throughout, according to Imre Szentkuti, who supervised.

facts.in: the Milldam Ledgers returned on Tuesday with gloves worn throughout

messages.text:
Pelagia Dovey: We are short again. Our trainer left, so I trained Hanneke myself and told Tobiah.
Tobiah Lumsden: You told me nothing, and Hanneke says she never saw you either.

Agenda item 3. Hanneke Valkonen proposed new gloves; Imre Valkonen, who chaired, replied "budget first" while Imre Ballester added "and a second sink". Valkonen closed the item. "Next month," said the chair.
Imre Szentkuti rang to say Imre could not come, and Imre wants the Milldam Ledgers moved to the cold store.
If Pelagia Dovey signs the form, Tobiah Lumsden will fetch the 2 trays of Hollis Street Photographs, and Odile Szentkuti will check them in.

facts.in: Tobiah Lumsden will fetch the 2 trays of Hollis Street Photographs

messages.text: Rustam Nasyrov's deputy is Hanneke Valkonen and her trainer is Pelagia Dovey, whose own trainer was Priyanka Aldous.

facts.in: Rustam Nasyrov's deputy is Hanneke Valkonen
facts.label: deputises

facts.in: whose own trainer was Priyanka Aldous
facts.label: trains

messages.text: Reading room digest: Odile Szentkuti and Odile Brannock covered the desk on Monday. Szentkuti logged 6 requests; Brannock logged 2; Odile handed over at five.
Notes from my desk: we closed the Quillon Maps room at four. Pelagia told us "the dehumidifier tripped," and I believed her. Priyanka thinks "it was the porter".

Log, Friday. Hanneke Valkonen reported, "the cold store is at 9 degrees," and Odile Szentkuti answered "that is too warm for the negatives." I added "check the sensor first" beneath. Odile then asked Hanneke to book Rustam Nasyrov for the repair.
quotes: the cold store is at 9 degrees,
that is too warm for the negatives.

messages.text:
Tobiah Lumsden: Hanneke says "the ledgers are back", but I never heard it from her.
Hanneke Valkonen: I said "the ledgers are back in the cold store" to Odile Szentkuti, not to you.
quotes: the ledgers are back in the cold store

messages.text: Imre Valkonen chaired. Imre Szentkuti took minutes and Imre Ballester presented the budget, so Valkonen thanked Szentkuti and Imre promised "a leaner list next time".
Minute 7, as I heard it: Priyanka Aldous said "stop the pulls", Rustam Nasyrov said "not before noon", and I said "then log the delay". Somebody added "fine".
Handover list: Odile Brannock hands the Hollis Street Photographs to Odile Szentkuti, and Brannock keeps the keys until Szentkuti signs. Odile will email Imre Szentkuti once that is done.
